actionConfiguration.body: SELECT agreement_template_id AS value, TRIM(name || CASE WHEN version IS NULL OR version='' THEN '' ELSE ' (' || version || ')' END) AS label, agreement_template_id, name, version, required_for, active, documenso_template_envelope_id FROM public.agreement_templates WHERE active = true AND {{ selAgreementType.selectedOptionValue || this.params.type_key }} = ANY(required_for) ORDER BY name, version DESC, created_at DESC;
